scene_context.physical_setting: Public park, paved pathway with benches, overcast weather (wet ground)
scene_context.emotional_atmosphere: Tense, accusatory, shifting from anxious to resolute

characters.physical_description: Adult female, black and white striped sleeveless top, black pants, carrying a black handbag

initial_state.body_language_summary: Rigid posture, direct approach, unsmiling, maintaining fixed gaze
initial_state.apparent_goal: To verify information and confront the male
behavioral_evidence: Walks directly toward male without greeting
Immediate verbal confrontation regarding his marital status

final_state.body_language_summary: Expansive gestures, upright posture, walking away decisively
final_state.apparent_goal: To terminate the interaction and assert boundaries
behavioral_evidence: Turns back and walks away without looking back
Brief period of listening/sitting (dip in assertiveness)
Initially looks hurt/conflicted when looking away (00:18)
Becomes cold and clinical by end of interaction

characters.physical_description: Adult male, black t-shirt, grey trousers, beard

initial_state.body_language_summary: Hands on hips, open stance, casual orientation
initial_state.apparent_goal: To understand why he was summoned

final_state.body_language_summary: Static posture, arms hanging loosely, watching her leave
behavioral_evidence: Stands still as she walks away
Then constructs elaborate narrative about 'formality' of divorce

desire_motivation_analysis.reasoning_chain: Character initiates contact -> Ignores pleasantries -> Demands binary confirmation ('Yes or No') -> Indicates need to resolve epistemic uncertainty regarding partner's status.

supporting_evidence.description: Demands 'Just tell me yes or no'

desire_motivation_analysis.reasoning_chain: Belief that relationship is threatened -> Desire to avoid breakup -> Intention to minimize the obstacle (the marriage) -> Behavior: pleading, explaining, physical touch.

supporting_evidence.description: Sits close on bench, places hand on her arm

alternative_interpretations.reasoning: He may be less concerned with losing her and more concerned with the social fallout of being caught.
alternative_interpretations.why_not_primary: His behavior focuses on emotional appeals ('I love you', 'afraid to lose you') rather than asking her to keep secrets.

desire_motivation_analysis.reasoning_chain: Character processes the explanation -> Rejects the role of 'second woman' -> Prioritizes self-respect over the relationship -> Terminates interaction.

supporting_evidence.description: Explicitly states refusal to be the 'second woman'

trigger_event.description: Male says 'Thank you for understanding' while touching her hand

behavioral_markers.description: Expression shifts from neutral/listening to disgust/anger

desire_transitions.visual_marker_of_change: The moment she looks down at his hand on her arm, her face hardens, and she physically recoils.
desire_transitions.psychological_interpretation: The male's presumption of forgiveness (Theory of Mind error) violated her internal values, triggering a shift from passive listening (considering his excuse) to active rejection (enforcing boundaries).

behavioral_markers.description: Hands drop from hips, defensive open-palm gestures begin
Eyebrows raise, mouth opens slightly (fear/surprise blend)

desire_transitions.visual_marker_of_change: The immediate drop in posture tension followed by rapid, defensive hand gesturing.
desire_transitions.psychological_interpretation: Belief update: Realization that his secret is known creates an immediate threat to his social standing and relationship, shifting motivation from casual greeting to crisis management.

behavioral_sequence.behavior_description: Sits on bench, leans in close, places hand on female's arm, lowers voice volume.
behavioral_sequence.inferred_mental_state: Attempting to establish intimacy and manipulate emotional response

behavioral_sequence.behavior_description: Breaks eye contact, looks off into the distance/side while male is speaking.
behavioral_sequence.relevance_to_desire: Suggests 'Cognitive_Information_Processing' - weighing his words against her knowledge.

key_segments_for_qa.segment_description: The turning point where the woman rejects the man's touch.
key_segments_for_qa.psychological_significance: Clear example of desire transition triggered by a violation of boundaries/values.

inter_character_dynamics.mutual_influence: Male attempts to de-escalate through intimacy; Female resists and escalates through moral assertion.

annotation_metadata.annotation_notes: The video depicts a classic 'discovery of infidelity' scenario. The male character displays classic gaslighting/minimization behaviors (claiming the marriage is a formality), while the female character demonstrates a shift from shock/hurt to self-preservation.
